item.title: Cabivella UK Architectural Cabinetry & Joinery
item.description: Cabivella manufactures specification-led bespoke cabinetry, high-durability kitchen suites, precision bathroom vanities and floor-to-ceiling fitted wardrobes. Engineered with moisture-sealed joinery substrates, Blum hardware mechanisms and durable lacquered finishes, our units arrive fully assembled directly from Turkish manufacturing facilities to British residential and commercial sites within 4 to 6 weeks.

item.title: Architectural Cabinetry Collections
item.description: Cabivella collections span six dedicated architectural cabinetry disciplines: bespoke made-to-measure kitchens, AquaShield moisture-sealed bathroom vanities, concealed pantry and larder suites, dedicated beverage coffee stations, floor-to-ceiling fitted wardrobes, and replacement cabinet front panels. All collections share unified British hardware standards and precision joinery tolerances.

item.title: Bespoke Made-to-Measure Kitchens
item.description: Cabivella kitchen cabinetry delivers bespoke millimeter-accurate spatial planning across contemporary handleless profiles, tactile fluted facades, and timeless five-piece timber shaker doors. Carcasses use 18mm high-density moisture-resistant melamine-faced chipboard with 1mm impact-absorbing ABS edging, completed with Blum soft-close runner systems and architectural pocket door configurations.

item.title: Architectural Bathroom Vanity Suites
item.description: Cabivella architectural bathroom suites combine thermo-fused moisture-resistant substrates with marine-grade polyurethane lacquer coatings. Designed to withstand relative humidity levels up to 95 percent without delaminating, each vanity integrates concealed waste cut-outs, integrated basin supports, and whisper-quiet soft-close drawer mechanisms engineered for daily British household use.

item.title: Bespoke Pantry & Larder Cupboard Joinery
item.description: Cabivella bespoke pantries and larder systems feature bi-folding pocket doors that slide entirely flush into carcass side voids. Interiors feature solid hardwood dovetailed drawers, adjustable spice shelving, integrated sensor-activated 3000K warm LED strips, and optional cold-surface quartz preparation worktops for dry culinary storage.

item.title: Integrated Bespoke Coffee Stations
item.description: Cabivella integrated coffee stations enclose professional espresso machines behind effortless bi-folding pocket facades. Each station features heat-resistant composite stone backsplashes, passive rear convection channels to prevent moisture entrapment, integrated electrical conduit feeds, and dedicated storage for glassware and artisanal coffee bean canisters.

item.title: Architectural Fitted Storage & Wardrobes
item.description: Cabivella fitted storage and wardrobe joinery maximizes vertical wall space with millimetric floor-to-ceiling framing. Configurable options include whisper-quiet sliding tracks, full-extension acoustic soft-close drawers, reeded glass display portals, built-in jewellery partitions, and flush scribing trims that accommodate uneven British period property walls and ceilings.

item.title: Bespoke Replacement Kitchen Doors & Fronts
item.description: Cabivella custom replacement doors allow homeowners to refresh existing kitchen carcasses with premium architectural facades. Each panel is precision-cut to custom dimensions and pre-drilled to match specified 35mm cup hinge positions. Finishes include moisture-resistant primed MDF for on-site finishing, durable polyurethane lacquer, and natural oak or walnut veneers.

item.title: Cabinetry Materials, Finishes & Hardware Standards
item.description: Cabivella specifies only certified E1 low-emission moisture-resistant MDF, birch core ply, and sustainably managed European oak and walnut veneers. Surface treatments employ multi-layer polyurethane lacquers tested against household chemical spills and thermal cycles, partnered exclusively with German-engineered Blum motion hardware rated for 200,000 opening cycles.

item.title: Our Story & Architectural Manufacturing Approach
item.description: Cabivella bridges bespoke cabinet-making traditions with state-of-the-art CNC joinery manufacturing. Operating from dedicated production facilities in Turkey with direct distribution across the UK and mainland Europe, we eliminate intermediary markups, providing architectural joinery solutions with transparent lead times, strict quality control, and dedicated English-speaking technical support.

item.title: Trade & Wholesale Cabinetry Supply UK
item.description: Cabivella Trade offers commercial specifications for UK developers, interior designers, and general building contractors. Trade partners gain dedicated account coordination, CAD/technical file checking, priority factory production scheduling, and phased palletised deliveries direct to site with complete customs clearance and UK VAT compliance handled transparently.

item.title: Enquire About Your Cabinetry Project
item.description: Initiate your project consultation by submitting approximate room dimensions, architectural PDF drawings, or hand-annotated sketches. Our UK joinery engineering team reviews structural requirements, verifies substrate moisture-resistance feasibility, and returns an itemized commercial quotation with detailed manufacturing lead-time commitments directly to your email within 48 business hours.

item.title: Privacy Policy & Data Protection
item.description: Cabivella processes client project data strictly in compliance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and Data Protection Act 2018. Client architectural plans, contact details, and site addresses are utilized exclusively for estimating, quotation delivery, and physical shipping logistics without third-party data monetization.

item.title: Cookie Policy & Consent Management
item.description: Cabivella uses minimal technical cookies solely to preserve active user interface preferences, maintain shopping cart specification state, and gather aggregate anonymous performance metrics via Google Analytics 4. We do not deploy intrusive third-party advertising tracking cookies, behavioral profiling pixels, or monetize visitor browsing data under any circumstances.
